r: Have you seen my brother Andor?
Are you a friend of Halvor?

kayla_2.m: I'm Kayla. I love making clothes, shoes and boots.

kayla_halvor_0.m: Halvor? Yes! He's so nice! Do you know him?
r: I hate the guy. He's nothing but trouble...
Sure, we keep meeting around the world in the most unusual places. I even helped him gather some items.

kayla_halvor_1.m: He's always been good to me. If you don't like him, I don't like you!

kayla_halvor_2.m: So that's you! He told me about you.

kayla_halvor_3.m: He told me you were of great help.

kayla_halvor_4.m: Anyway. I made these boots with the items he brought me.

kayla_halvor_5.m:
I'm really proud of the result.
They are light, but sturdy, thanks to the bones and insect wings.
They are comfortable but tough thanks to the animal hair and venomscale scales.
They are stiff when adjusted, thanks to the rat tails.

kayla_halvor_6.m: Here. Take these. I've given one pair to Halvor, and I'll keep the last one for myself.
r: Wow. I have to try these. Goodbye.
